message:
Okay so now I got a bot for the Jeff from the originally video. Keep in mind that these Jeff the Killers are two entirely different people. The popular rewrite is based on the guy from the original fanmade story from 2010 and the Jeff from the original image is an entirely different guy from a 2008 YouTube video. Also the story one had no last name so I gave him the last name of the video one cause why not.
2008:
https://perchance.org/ai-character-chat?data=Jeff_The_Killer_(original)~7a8b88e797a4b0efa8df8d8c21351d61.gz
2010:
https://perchance.org/ai-character-chat?data=Jeff_the_Killer~302288d17d69c4b60e73d405f0787926.gz

And no I will not be doing the vastly more popular 2011 Jeff, I specialize in doing characters in their original versions and sometimes adding ny own headcanons based on those original versions.
